   10  // A card, as the actor stores and returns it and the page renders it.
   11  // version is optimistic locking: every move bumps it, and a move only
   12  // applies when the caller's expectVersion matches the row's version.

   15  export interface Card {
   16    id: number
   17    title: string
   18    owner: string
   19    column: ColumnId
   20    version: number
   21    movedBy: string | null
   22    movedAt: number | null
   23  }
   24  
   25  // A live-update message. After every change the actor publishes one of
   26  // these on the 'cards' room topic and the server pushes it to every open
   27  // page, which re-lists the cards. A discriminated union on 'type';
   28  // parseBoardEvent narrows the raw room payload (which arrives as
   29  // unknown) to it.
   30  // In both variants `by` is the name of the visitor who did it — never the
   31  // card's owner.
   32  export type BoardEvent =
   33    | { type: 'moved'; id: number; column: ColumnId; by: string }
   34    | { type: 'added'; id: number; title: string; by: string }
   35  
   36  // The room delivers payloads as plain JSON, untyped: check one before
   37  // trusting it, and ignore anything that is not a well-formed BoardEvent.
   38  export function parseBoardEvent(raw: unknown): BoardEvent | null {
   39    if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null || Array.isArray(raw)) return null
   40    const o = raw as Record<string, unknown>
   41    const by = o['by']
   42    const id = o['id']
   43    if (typeof by !== 'string' || typeof id !== 'number') return null
   44    if (o['type'] === 'moved') {
   45      const column = o['column']
   46      if (typeof column === 'string' && (COLUMNS as readonly string[]).includes(column)) {
   47        return { type: 'moved', id, by, column: column as ColumnId }
   48      }
   49      return null
   50    }
   51    if (o['type'] === 'added') {
   52      const title = o['title']
   53      if (typeof title === 'string') return { type: 'added', id, by, title }
   54      return null
   55    }
   56    return null
   57  }
   58  
   59  // The room delivers each push wrapped in an envelope:
   60  // { topic: 'cards', data: <BoardEvent>, isMe: boolean, peer, ... } —
   61  // narrowed once, here, so the page never touches an unknown.
   62  // isMe is the server's word for whether this connection emitted the
   63  // event. It is trusted over matching display names, which can collide.
   64  export interface BoardEnvelope {
   65    event: BoardEvent
   66    isMe: boolean
   67  }
   68  
   69  export function parseBoardEnvelope(raw: unknown): BoardEnvelope | null {
   70    if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null || Array.isArray(raw)) return null
   71    const o = raw as Record<string, unknown>
   72    const event = parseBoardEvent(o['data'])
   73    if (event === null) return null
   74    return { event, isMe: o['isMe'] === true }
